sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body:
This is a placeholder paragraph showing how a short heading stays glued to its first paragraph even when a page break would otherwise land between them.

A second paragraph in the same section flows normally afterward, and can spill onto the next page without dragging the heading down with it.

sections.heading: 2. Background
sections.body: Dense administrative and legal documents are usually assembled from several source paragraphs of very different lengths. Without explicit pagination hints, a layout engine will happily orphan a one-line heading at the bottom of a page.

sections.heading: 3. Requested Action
sections.body: Replace this JSON with your own title, meta lines, and sections — the script handles the rest: tight A4 margins, justified body text, and heading/paragraph pairs that never get split across a page break.
